As a Special Tourist Zone, the administration, control, management,
preservation, development and supervision of the above-mentioned portions of the
Manila Bay and its foreshore area thereof is placed upon the Philippine Tourism
Authority (PT A). The PT A shall within sixty (60) days from effectivity of this Order
submit to the Office of the President its comprehensive plan on the development,
preservation and management of the above-mentioned Special Tourist Zone, with its
metes and bounds.
